title: Crane as the Navy's off-world reverse-engineering center
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Crane as the Navy's off-world reverse-engineering center, about present at Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane; Wright-Patterson AFB, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane; Wright-Patterson AFB

tellings.quote: my contacts told me that if rright Patterson is the center of the Air Force's most exotic off-world reverse engineer engineering efforts Naval surface Warfare crane is the center of the Navy's off-world reverse engineering efforts

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says his contacts told him something about two military sites. According to them, Wright-Patterson, an Air Force base, is the center of the Air Force's most exotic efforts to take apart and copy technology not made on Earth, and Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, a Navy research base, is the Navy's center for the same kind of work. If true, both services would each have their own hub for studying off-world technology.
